Gun-armed Mi-24P. Construction number 3532431622374. Western row of the open park; russianplanes.net monument card 7641.
Czechoslovak L-29 Delfin jet trainer, construction number 390418. Listed by the English Wikipedia collection list and by russianplanes.net monument card 846.

Great Patriotic War halls 6a/6b; the museum's own hall description lists one Li-2 among the wartime aircraft. Wears bort number 39; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.

Czechoslovak L-200D Morava light twin, construction number 171103; russianplanes.net monument card 7690.

Aerobatic Yak-18PM, construction number 700112; russianplanes.net monument card 7704. Wears bort number 10; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.

Aerobatic single-seater; russianplanes.net monument card 7692 gives the construction number as 002 with a query, so it is not recorded here.
Full-scale replica, flagged as a replica on russianplanes.net monument card 7672. No bort number recorded.
Full-scale mock-up of the BI rocket fighter, flagged as a mock-up on russianplanes.net monument card 7671 and described as a scale model by the kpopov.ru survey. Not an original airframe.

Full-scale replica amphibian, in the museum since 2021 per russianplanes.net monument card 10977. Carries a Soviet-style civil marking beginning CCCP-P that could not be read in full, so no registration is recorded.
Flying replica built in 1975 for the feature film Vozduhoplavatel, per the kpopov.ru survey of the Monino collection; russianplanes.net monument card 23588. Not an original 1910 airframe.
Three-surface light multipurpose aircraft by NPO Molniya, construction number 104; russianplanes.net monument card 7642. Parked in the northern storage area of the museum grounds.

Wingless jet-lift flying test rig of 1956-1958 used to develop VTOL control; construction number 370, russianplanes.net monument card 7701. It has no lifting surfaces at all, so the wing type field is nominal.
Single-seat high-performance sailplane; russianplanes.net monument card 7687. No construction number or bort number recorded.
Aerobatic sailplane; russianplanes.net monument card 7656. No construction number or bort number recorded.
Single-seat competition sailplane; russianplanes.net monument card 7655. No construction number or bort number recorded.
Sailplane built at the Kazan Aviation Institute; russianplanes.net monument card 7715. No construction number or bort number recorded.
Sailplane built at the Moscow Aviation Institute; russianplanes.net monument cards 7697 and 24360 both describe this airframe.

Circular-wing experimental glider of 1950 designed by M. V. Sukhanov, per the kpopov.ru survey; russianplanes.net monument card 7686. Year of construction not recorded here because the source gives a design year for the type.
Second circular-wing experimental glider, of 1962, with a 4.9 m diameter wing, per the kpopov.ru survey; russianplanes.net monument card 7654 lists it simply as Diskoplan.
Burevestnik S-4 glider by V. P. Nevdachin; russianplanes.net monument card 7713. No construction number recorded.
Sub-scale unmanned orbital test vehicle for the Buran programme, airframe number 502, flown 17 April 1985 per the kpopov.ru survey; russianplanes.net monument card 7684.
